locked_story.headline: Alaska's stroke network bets on AI: RapidAI software that flags suspected large vessel occlusion strokes on CT scans is spreading across Alaska hospitals through the volunteer Alaska Stroke Coalition, with federal Rural Health Transformation money extending an AI imaging network to 21 acute care hospitals, in a state with five clot-removal specialists; the coalition says it can't yet prove statistically better outcomes (STAT, November 24th; CMS)
locked_story.note: Two of four researchers independently surfaced it. In window (STAT November 24th). dedupe.py check FRESH; no stroke or RapidAI story in config/state.yaml dispatch_history. Genuine deployed ML (imaging triage) on Alaska patients, with an honest built-in limit (no outcome proof yet).

rungs.note: 4 researchers (energy/policy/business, science/fisheries, defense/rural/health, wildcard/primary-source mining), about 75 of 80 WebSearch calls, about 120 uncapped WebFetches. All four called it a slow Thanksgiving week.
Covered inside round one: ADN, Alaska Public, Alaska Beacon, KTOO, Alaska's News Source, News-Miner, Must Read Alaska, Juneau Empire, KDLL, KYUK, KUCB, KNOM, Alaska Native News indexes read.
